paragraphs: Dil Gurung is a highly experienced adventure trekking guide and an avid trekker who has been exploring the Himalayas of Nepal since 2004 . Before founding his own company, he worked extensively in the tourism industry as a trekking guide, tour guide, and mountaineering assistant, gaining hands-on experience along major trekking routes across Nepal.

In 2014, Dil established Nepal Unique Treks , a trusted trekking agency based in Kathmandu. As a passionate travel and tourism entrepreneur, he possesses in-depth knowledge of nearly every region in Nepal. His expertise and dedication make him one of the most reliable and well-experienced trekking and tour organizers in the country. As an outdoor operator, he leads and manages trekking teams with a strong sense of responsibility and professionalism.

Dil Gurung understands exactly what trekkers seek when visiting Nepal. He has personally crafted each itinerary offered by Nepal Unique Treks , drawing from his firsthand experience of trekking almost every trail in the Himalayas. His deep familiarity with the terrain ensures that each route delivers the most memorable and rewarding experience for travelers.
